text: How to withdraw NFT from Binance you can now deposit and withdraw your NFTs from Binance NFT Marketplace via the website or the Binance app. How to withdraw NFT From Binance Step 1 Select NFT Log in to your Binance account and go to nft. Click User Center Withdraw, select the NFT you would like to withdraw under NFT Asset or Mystery Boxes and click Confirm. Please note that unopened Mystery boxes cannot be withdrawn. For NFTs opened from mystery Boxes, visit the Product page and click on the NFT to find the token id. If you have more than one NFT from the same series, please choose the specific token ID of the NFT you want to withdraw. Alternatively, you can also click Withdraw on the listing page to withdraw the nft. After selecting your nft, the system will display the corresponding network in which the asset is kept. Please make sure you have the selected network's native coins in your wallet to pay for the gas fee. The withdrawal fees are subject to change according to the network status. Step 2 Connect your wallet choose the wallet address that you would like to withdraw to under Destination Wallet Address. If you haven't connected any wallet, click Add a Wallet. You you will be redirected to the Connect Wallet page. Choose the network of your wallet and click Confirm. Select the wallet you want to connect. You can Choose MetaMask or WalletConnect. Please select a compatible network for your NFT or your assets might be lost and cannot be recovered. For a step by step guide, you may check out the Wallet Connection guides on Binance FAQ. STEP 3 Confirm details and withdraw Check the network and destination wallet address. Click Confirm to Withdraw. Once the process is complete, you can find the NFT withdrawal records in history, deposits and withdrawals. Visit Binance NFT Marketplace today to list and trade your NFTs.
